categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Neoway Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the IoT wireless communication modules, IoT wireless communication terminals, IoT wireless communication solutions, and cloud products including cloud platforms and cloud infrastructure. The company designs, develops, outsources production, and sells these products and solutions, serving sectors such as smart energy, automotive networking, urban IoT sensing, mobile broadband IoT, commercial retail, and industrial IoT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company masters five core foundational technologies: cellular communication, reliability, application layer protocols, baseband and RF technology, embedded software, and cloud platform technology. It develops advanced wireless communication modules supporting 2G to 5G including NB-IoT, Cat-M, and V2X standards, integrating AI technologies into IoT modules and terminals. Production is outsourced to specialized manufacturers mainly in the Pearl River Delta, with strict quality and technology control to protect core IP.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities, large enterprises, and industry players in smart energy (electricity, water, gas), automotive networking, urban sensing, and cloud infrastructure sectors. The company serves domestic Chinese markets extensively and has significant overseas presence in India, Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East, particularly in smart grid and automotive IoT markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and R&D centers in Shenzhen, Dongguan, and Xi'an. It has expanded its market reach to overseas regions including India, Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East, maintaining leading market shares in smart grid sectors in India and other countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Neoway operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IoT supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and sales of wireless communication modules, terminals, and cloud solutions. It procures chips and components from upstream semiconductor manufacturers domestically and internationally, while outsourcing manufacturing to specialized contract manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in 5G, 4G, NB-IoT, V2X wireless communication modules, and AI integration into IoT products. It invests in developing AI modules and terminals, cloud platforms, and cloud infrastructure products to support data storage and computing needs. Neoway emphasizes innovation in low power consumption, high reliability, security, and multi-standard compatibility, aiming to lead in smart energy, automotive networking, urban sensing, and AI-enabled IoT applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of IoT wireless communication modules, terminals, communication solutions, and cloud products. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to large customers and supplemented by distributors for fragmented markets. Cloud platform and infrastructure sales involve contract-based deployments and acceptance. The company also receives government subsidies and rebates that impact revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Neoway is a leading player in the smart grid wireless communication module market in China and holds a dominant position in India and other overseas smart grid markets. It competes with domestic and international IoT module manufacturers and differentiates itself through integrated 'cloud-management-terminal' solutions and AI-enabled products. The company is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion'.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.07 billion, a 229% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 100 million, turning profitable after previous losses. Total assets reached RMB 1.77 billion, up 13%, with net assets increasing 14.8%. The company’s R&D investment was RMB 95 million, accounting for 3.1% of revenue. The growth is driven by expansion in overseas smart grid markets, domestic automotive networking, and cloud product sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Neoway emphasizes providing stable, reliable, secure IoT connectivity solutions covering the full data lifecycle from collection, transmission, cleaning, computing to storage and disaster recovery. Its unique 'cloud-management-terminal' architecture integrates wireless communication modules, terminals, cloud platforms, and cloud infrastructure to deliver comprehensive IoT big data solutions. The company’s deep industry understanding, advanced core technologies, and AI integration enable tailored solutions for diverse applications, enhancing customer value and competitive differentiation.
